summary: One consolidated behavior release: smoother suggestion-letter continuity and BR Brain at the top of Settings, preserving previously shipped editor, Emoji, trackpad, correction and private voice safeguards.

changes.title: Prediction letters now move into their new positions
changes.detail: On the iOS-style motion profile, the three existing suggestion slots render unchanged English letters shifting smoothly, replacing only outgoing and incoming glyphs. Expansion such as they to they're, contraction, inner-word replacements and fast consecutive predictions no longer depend on a suffix-only fade. Actual suggestions and tappable targets update immediately; no new predictive-engine delay. Complex-script and long-word suggestions retain the native TextView fallback. Precise iOS 27 frame measurements are not claimed.

changes.title: Interrupted suggestion animations retarget from visible letters
changes.detail: When a newer prediction arrives mid-animation, the next transition begins at the currently drawn glyph positions and transparency, keeping the real latest word authoritative with one renderer per slot. Existing center confidence capsule, reduced-motion policy, no-cross-slot behavior and Previous Default preset remain intact.

changes.title: BR Brain appears at the top of the Settings home
changes.detail: A dedicated first-screen BR Brain card opens existing live offline prediction and learning diagnostics directly, without hiding the dashboard under Dictionary. Version history remains available in About with release-specific detail and publication time.

changes.title: Earlier behavioral and privacy work preserved
changes.detail: Retains session-scoped Emoji category navigation, guarded two-finger trackpad selection, safe autocorrection reversal, five encrypted undelivered-transcript recovery cards, field privacy checks and original offline Parakeet 110M voice path. No new network permission, model or migration; no data reset or change to signing identity. Oppo visual and TalkBack acceptance is still required.
